title: Recognize the series
text: This is a geometric series with first term $$\frac{1}{x-3}$$ and ratio $$\frac{1}{\left(x-3\right)^2}$$.

title: Sum it
text: Its sum is $$\frac{\frac{1}{x-3}}{1-\frac{1}{\left(x-3\right)^2}}$$. Multiply the top and bottom by $$\left(x-3\right)^2$$ to get $$\frac{x-3}{\left(x-3\right)^2-1}$$.
